messages:
alex: quick sync — EdgePilot pilot asks from two customers landed: AcmeHealth and RapidChat. both want specific guidance: batching + prefix caching recommendations, quantized fallbacks, and eval-triggered alerts tied to quality regressions. can we lock a minimal launch scope by EOW?
priya: can you share the top customer success scenarios? how strict are their latency SLAs?
sam: AcmeHealth: strict P95 250–300ms for short chats. RapidChat: cares about cost per 10k tokens, will accept slightly higher latency if cost drops. both want automatic quality alerts (eval-triggered) to avoid silent regressions.
mila: sounds like we need two prioritized paths: latency-first (Acme) and econ-first (Rapid). recommend different defaults for batching/caching/quant profiles.
alex: exact. proposal: three launch lanes
- lane A: latency-first — small batches, aggressive prefix KV caching, no quant unless >1s tail latency.
- lane B: econ-first — larger batching, model-level int8 quant fallback, opportunistic cache.
- lane C: safety/canary — deploy with eval-triggered alerts and rollback hooks.
priya: who owns the eval-alert integration? ops-bot: eval-sentry v2 is available, can emit events to /alerts with tags: {pilot,customer,model,delta}.
priya: great — we need acceptance criteria for eval-alerts. propose: alert within 5m of regression, include top N failing prompts, severity triage to oncall.
sam: acceptance for launch:
- p95 latency for lane A <= 300ms for canonical small-chat workload
- econ lane reduces per-token cost by >= 20% vs baseline (measured over 24h)
- eval-alerts fire with top 10 counterexamples and link to runbook within 5m
- automatic quant-fallback triggered only when quality delta <= 1.5% on eval set
mila: question: how do we measure "quality delta" for quant fallback? we need a standardized eval set per customer or use golden prompts.
cassidy: Ops/SEs should be able to upload a small golden set (50–200 prompts). system runs quick pass in inference sandbox to validate quant variant before routing.
alex: technical note: for quant fallback we need KV cache versioning and cross-variant KV compatibility. if that isn't solved, fallbacks must warm cache (costly).
sam: pragmatic MVP: disallow cross-variant KV sharing. instead document the cost and warm-up expectations. automatic fallback needs a rate limit and budget guard.
priya: rollout plan? canary percentages?
mila: propose: canary 5% traffic lane C for 48h, if no eval-alerts and latency stable -> 20% for 24h -> full. econ lane launches behind opt-in flag for customers.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: can create canary with tags (edgepilot, lane-c, acme). need owner.
alex: owner: @sam for runtime work, @priya for acceptance & cust comms, @mila for rollout gating.
sam: implementation notes: batching policy example (rough):
```json
{
  "policy_name": "edgepilot-econ",
  "max_batch_tokens": 4096,
  "max_batch_size": 32,
  "latency_target_ms": 500,
  "prefetch_prefix_kv": true
}
```
keep these as defaults per lane.
priya: eval-alert rule example: if metric delta (rouge/bleu/embedding-sim) > threshold for > 3m -> create P1 if regression impacts >5% requests
mila: for customer-facing docs we must call out:
- what "quant fallback" means (possible minor style shifts)
- warm-up CPU/GPU cost during fallbacks
- how to upload golden eval sets and how alerts will surface in console
cassidy: also need SLOs for alerts: false positive rate target < 8% for first 30 days. ops will tune thresholds.
alex: risks: cross-variant cache invalidation, noisy eval signals, overfitting to small golden sets. mitigations: run multi-customer shadow tests and include model-level holdouts.
sam: timeline:
- this week: finalize launch acceptance criteria + one-pager for customers (owner priya)
- next week: runtime PR for per-lane batching defaults + quant fallback gate (owner sam)
- week after: enable eval-alert integration + create runbook + canary deploy (owner mila/cassidy)
priya: internal ask: legal/security needs a checklist for AcmeHealth (regulated). we'll need KMS approvals for example artifacts.
alex: noted. cassidy, pls add security checklist item.
cassidy: added to backlog.
priya: small ask: can we add a short CLI to upload golden sets and trigger a local quant validation? helps SEs onboard.
sam: yep will add `ri pilot validate-golden --customer acme --variant int8` as a small tool.
ops-bot: ack: created ticket INF-4321 for canary orchestration.
alex: OK — decision for this thread: accept the 3-lane launch scope, owners assigned, acceptance criteria above. next check-in Thu 11am PT.
mila: :thumbsup: I'll draft the customer one-pager and add the schema for eval-alert payloads.
priya: thanks everyone — I'll loop in SEs for AcmeHealth and RapidChat after Thu.
sam: copying notes into the project board now.
alex: end.
